question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be static, runtime-served, or documented as a TypeBox/JSON Schema client-generation path?
rationale: The answer defines public API coverage, auth visibility, plugin-route exposure, versioning, and upgrade compatibility, which automation should not choose from the current source layout alone.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, and security/versioning rules.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a versioned schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint until auth and plugin-route exposure are settled.

options.title: Use Existing Protocol Docs
options.body: Close later only if maintainers explicitly decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema and Gateway RPC docs are the supported client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, and security/versioning rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal across the current Gateway protocol, HTTP router, and docs surfaces.
